Running tweeks

The vast majority of my running is solitary (well with dug) now, but I am always intrigued by research that points to improvements, be they pace or injury reduction (always very interested that!).
The Human Locomotion Lab at the University of Texas does some interesting work. ‘Stiffer socks’ have the potential of improving energy efficiency by 2% (Beck et al), but this also interested me —https://journals.physiology.org/doi/full/10.1152/japplphysiol.00886.2025

for more, https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=YI99LWwAAAAJ&hl=en&authuser=1
